# Minecraft rd-132211: Widescreen-Fix

![](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-rd--132211-orange?style=flat-square)
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/fix-widescreen-blue?style=flat-square)
![](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green?style=flat-square)

A simple mod patch for Minecraft **rd-132211**. allowing you to play Minecraft with modern widescreen support

---

## Features

* **Native Widescreen Display:** Forces the game canvas to boot into a crisp, standardized **1280 × 720 (720p)** aspect ratio right out of the box.
* **Mouse Cursor Unlock:** Simply press the **`L`** key to release your cursor from the window lock. No more getting trapped in the game frame!
* **Window Resizing:** unlocks the window borders, allowing you to drag and resize the window to any resolution.

---

## Controls & Hotkeys

| Key | Action |
| :---: | :--- |
| L | **Unlock / Release Mouse Cursor** |
| F11 | **Fullscreen** |
---
